page: Microsoft Azure NC40ads_H100_v5 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V84 processor running at 3.7 GHz. It features 40 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 320.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and a bundled 3971 GB NVMe SSD for high-speed local storage. Acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU equipped with 94 GB of VRAM.

Benchmark evaluations place this server in the top tier for multi-core Geekbench performance and image processing, alongside a top-tier PassMark memory score. It demonstrates strong performance in stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, PassMark CPU encryption, and Redis SET operations, which reach 100.89 million operations per second. For large-scale data tasks, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is strong at 525.91 GB/sec, while static web serving throughput and single-threaded compression remain in the average tier. Large-block read memory bandwidth is average at 182.31 GB/sec, whereas write bandwidth is strong at 91.33 GB/sec.

In language model execution, the server achieves a strong text generation speed of 286.08 tokens per second for small 135M models and 33.22 tokens per second for medium 7B models, dropping to an average of 3.88 tokens per second for large 70B models. This hardware profile is optimized for GPU-accelerated workloads, including machine learning model training, LLM inference, image processing, and high-performance database operations. The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC cores, high-capacity local NVMe storage, and Hopper GPU architecture delivers a high-density resource profile suitable for compute-intensive and data-heavy enterprise applications.
